label: F-07
title: story-007 premise that _pools[i] is used by zap swap types 3/5/7 is false; deployed Router NG v1.1 reads pools only for swap_type 3; ICurveRouterNG NatSpec copies it
description: story-007 premise that _pools[i] is used by zap swap types 3/5/7 is false; deployed Router NG v1.1 reads pools only for swap_type 3; ICurveRouterNG NatSpec copies it
impact: None. Executed-hop pools are unconstrained and the router reads them only for swap_type 3, so behaviour is correct; risk is only that a future validator built on the '3/5/7' premise would be wrong.
impactSummary: Docs only; behaviour unaffected (executed-hop pools unconstrained, still correct for type 3). Risk: misleads a future validator that ties pools to swap_type.
severityRationale: Documentation/story premise error (pools used by 3/5/7 vs only 3 in deployed v1.1) with no behavioural effect; Info spec-conformance, kept separate from F-06 (different story, different false statement).

instances.note: loose ('zap swap types use them'), not false

recommendation: Change '3/5/7' to 'swap_type 3 only' in ICurveRouterNG.sol (and story-007 Background if the owner amends stories).
